reviews.text: They care about my doggy and they care well
A welcoming and professional team. The best clinic I've ever used for my cats. Excellent service and helpful advice at every visit. You can tell the clinic truly cares about animal welfare.

Amazing vet and team! Dr. Marku and his team are super knowledgeable, empathetic, and very transparent with their pricing. They also provide good advice and do their best to adapt to your situation and concerns. They even went above and beyond for a stray cat that I found! Rest assured your pets are in good hands here 🙏 …
Super great and friendly staff, Dr. Marku geniuely cares about animals and that is very refreshing to see. ✨

It was worth to travel from Ottawa to this place.Everyone was friendly and caring people!Dr.Marku is an amazing vet and a wonderful human being!Being there and explained what was going on with Bingo's paw was a relief.Just a month before this visit,we were told at animal emergency hospital to put Bingo down or ampiutede Bingo's paw.But Thank you to Dr.Marku Bingo today is a Happy boy and still has a long life ahead.Dr.Marku's expertise explained any questions or doubts we have.
We are very very Thankful to Dr.Marku and all the stuff of this veterinary  clinic!
Lucky you people in Montreal that have your animals take care from this Doctor!
Many many Thanks to all the stuff and Dr.Marku !
Same vet for the past 6 years now
An impeccable team and service

Dr. Marku cared for my parents' cocker spaniels, Carbone and Watson, throughout their lives. His skill and empathy make all the difference. If my schedule allowed, I would make the trip to Terrebonne to have my dog ​​treated, because I know he would be in good hands.
A very dedicated and professional team. They even called us a few days later to ask about our cat and gave us even more advice on how to help him.

My two dogs have been treated by Dr. Marku and his team. The service is extraordinarily empathetic, both towards humans and their four-legged patients. I often have minor issues with my dog ​​who has allergies, and the team makes every effort to see us quickly. The entire team is friendly, and my dog ​​loves going there (and not just for the treats she gets!). The fees are reasonable and offer budget-friendly options.
I have nothing but praise for this clinic. Dr. Maku and his team have always demonstrated kindness, gentleness, empathy, and professionalism!

A well-equipped, independent clinic.

A very good experience in an emergency situation requiring no appointment. The doctor thoroughly explained my pet's health issues to me, without pressuring me, allowing me to make an informed decision regarding the possibility of euthanasia.

Finding an effective medication despite the limitations on testing I had imposed was definitely a great success!

Note that they open early, but they also close early.

The quality of care I received was outstanding. The veterinarian and his assistant took the time to explain in detail the care my cat needed, demonstrating a loving approach and providing excellent information. I have visited several clinics, and in none have I received such valuable information. I deeply appreciate their dedication and highly recommend them.
Excellent veterinary hospital! Everyone is very friendly, my animals were very well taken care of.

The best part of my visit was being insulted and talked down to by an incoherent veterinarian who has already been struck off the register several times by the Quebec Order of Veterinarians. I can't believe it's possible to speak to pet owners like that and that this hostile behavior is tolerated. The entire staff, from the receptionist to the veterinarian, is a complete disaster. Paying for my pet's care is fine, but supporting a practice like this is a definite no. I will therefore continue my pet's care elsewhere! It's that simple!

Addendum to my comment following your response: Firstly, there is no defamatory information or superfluous accusation in this review; I have nothing to gain from it. Secondly, regarding the striking off due to several breaches (which are repeat offenses, by the way), this information can be found on the Quebec Order of Veterinarians' website, and you should be grateful that I didn't name the individual in question. 😊 Finally, if you want a customer to directly address their comments to the "appropriate staff," start by teaching your employees basic respect. This situation has already been reported to the higher authorities. You're accumulating complaints... a review of your conduct might be warranted. Have a good day anyway!

P.S.: Treating people with disdain and insulting them gratuitously in this way demonstrates a problem, so I hope you will resolve this internal issue in the future.

My one and only vet for all 5 of my animals.
They really really really care about the animals. Pricing is good, and they don't make you feel bad or judged if you don't get certain meds because you can't afford it right away. Let's face it, vets are expensive and where they can cut costs they do, and I always appreciate it.
They took care of my cat and helped her not be stressed during the procedures.
A very caring team who truly have the well-being of the animals at heart. I've been going there with my cats for several years and I trust them 100%.

Excellent team and excellent veterinarian! Dr. Marku has always been there for my two cats, Guzzi and Luna. Thank you for your excellent service over these past four years! I recommend you 200%!
Thanks again! ;)

Dr. Marku and his team are the best family veterinarians I've ever had the pleasure of meeting. They are experts with a wonderful sense of humanity, and they will make recommendations based on your pet's needs without ever putting you under pressure. As a new dog owner with a medical history, on a tight budget, and with no prior experience, I received a welcome and understanding I hadn't experienced anywhere else. Dr. Marku has supported my family through adoptions and losses, and while I'm now moving to another area, if I could continue coming here, I would. It seems like a great workplace too, on a human scale, and the staff are always helpful, friendly, and warm. Thank you to the whole team, and I will miss you all very much.

A great clinic with very warm and welcoming staff. They also offer reserved parking for their clients. I brought in my cat for booster vaccinations and got tests done there, a very pleasant experience through and through, they really love and care for animals. Thank you Dr. Marku and Justina for your care and professionalism 🙏🏻 …
Excellent service. Everyone is friendly and it's clear that animals are their passion. The vet is honest and takes the time to answer all questions.
Very good service, they love animals and it shows!
Thank you Nikola

My cats have been receiving care from Dr. Marku and his team for 14 years. I trust them completely with their lives and health. One of my cats had a severe urinary blockage and recovered thanks to Dr. Marku. Thank you to the entire team and also to Cristina, who ensures the smooth running of the clinic.
excellent service. vet & staff are super professional and kind.
Professionals who love animals and treat them as sentient beings deserving of the best care. Dr. Marku and his team are fantastic.
Best customer service! I highly recommend - a great family run business.
The best one ever, very kind people and best costumers service

Hello Marc,
We can't find any record of your visit to our clinic. If you did visit our facility, we would appreciate more details about your experience to better understand and, if necessary, improve our services. Thank you.
